$comment: Grok Build adapter for the ADK session contract gate. Grok reads <project>/.claude/settings.json hooks natively (compat.claude.hooks, folder trust required: /hooks-trust). This file repeats the two gate commands byte-identically so enforcement survives compat.claude.hooks=false; identical handlers are deduplicated by Grok. Grok sends Claude-compatible snake_case fields (session_id, cwd, tool_name, tool_input, tool_use_id) and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, under its own tool names (run_terminal_command, search_replace) which the gate maps.
